text:
alex (Partnerships): Heads up — need alignment on the private-offer renewal structure for the Q3 appliance bundles + SI credits. Thinking: 12-month committed spend with a staged credit release tied to renewal milestones. Thoughts?
maria (Sales): Love staged release. can we keep 10/20/70 split by month 0/6/12? keeps churn incentives. :thumbsup:
sam (Finance): Need unit economics calc. 10/20/70 looks aggressive on credits at end. suggest 20/30/50 instead so ARR recognized earlier. I can run numbers.
julie (Legal): Contract note — any credit that looks like "cash equivalent" needs explicit clause about redemption window and transferability. also check marketplace private offer T&Cs re: credits stacking.
devin (SI Lead): From SI side, we want credits frontloaded to help deployment momentum. If customers get too little early they delay integration. can we do a small onboarding kicker (5%) at month 1 + the rest staged?
annika (Ops): Marketplace listing timing matters — announcements should go after private-offer is live in the marketplace to avoid customer confusion. Ops needs 10 business days to sync SKUs and entitlements.
ops-bot: Reminder: marketplace sync job scheduled weekly on Tue 09:00PT. Next run in 6 days.
alex (Partnerships): OK tradeoffs noted: Finance prefers 20/30/50; SI wants early kicker. Legal needs clauses. Ops wants 10 business days.
maria (Sales): Proposal: 15% onboarding kicker at month 1, then 25% at month 6, 60% at renewal month 12. discount ladder: 10% list discount + credit stack. this hits sales motions for pilots.
sam (Finance): Run that through ARR model. rough quick check: onboarding kicker increases short-term spend by ~5-7% DP (deployment pace) which is fine. will ping with updated CAC impact.
julie (Legal): I'll draft clause language: "Marketplace credits issued under private offers are non-transferable, valid for 12 months from issuance, and redeemable only against Redwood Inference consumption SKUs specified in the private offer." will share PR.
devin (SI Lead): For announcement cadence: recommend co-announcement with HW partner + SI case study 6 weeks after GA. we can mobilize customer X for a quote.
annika (Ops): Locking calendar: if we want announcement 6 weeks post-GA, GA must be by Tue Jul 2 to make partner marketing windows. Ops needs final SKU metadata by Mon Jun 17.
alex (Partnerships): Action items: (1) Sam run ARR/CAC sensitivity for 15/25/60 split (due Fri), (2) Julie draft credit clause + T&Cs (due Wed), (3) Maria and Devin confirm pilot customer for case study (due Thu), (4) Annika confirm marketplace sync date and ops checklist (due Tue). I'll compile and loop in HW partner PM. :rocket:
maria (Sales): acked. ping me if you need revenue uplift sketch.
sam (Finance): on it. will post numbers in thread when ready.
julie (Legal): starting draft.
devin (SI Lead): I'll check with customer X and HW PM.
annika (Ops): reserving sync window.
alex (Partnerships): Thanks all. tagging @devin @maria for visibility. will update thread when docs are in.
